<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" class="dark scroll-smooth">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Gautam (Gautam369) — 3D Single-Origin GitHub Portfolio & README Hub</title>
  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.17"></script>
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
  <script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@0.469.0/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <script>
    tailwind.config = {
      darkMode: 'class',
      theme: {
        extend: {
          fontFamily: {
            sans: ['Inter', 'sans-serif'],
            mono: ['JetBrains Mono', 'monospace'],
          }
        }
      }
    };
  </script>
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg-primary: #060914;
      --bg-secondary: #0f172a;
      --accent-primary: #00f2fe;
      --accent-secondary: #6366f1;
      --glow-rgba: rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.24);
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      color: #f8fafc;
      background-color: #060914;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    /* Dynamic Scroll-Transforming Backdrop Layer */
    #scroll-backdrop {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: -2;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 18% 22%, var(--glow-rgba), transparent 48%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 82% 76%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.20), transparent 52%),
        linear-gradient(145deg, var(--bg-primary) 0%, var(--bg-secondary) 100%);
      transition: background 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    }

    /* Cyber Grid Overlay that shifts perspective on scroll */
    #cyber-grid {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: -1;
      background-image:
        linear-gradient(to right, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 48px 48px;
      mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(0,0,0,0.85) 20%, transparent 80%);
      -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(0,0,0,0.85) 20%, transparent 80%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    #webgl-canvas {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100vw;
      height: 100vh;
      z-index: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    /* 3D Perspective Cards */
    .perspective-container {
      perspective: 1200px;
    }

    .tilt-card {
      transform-style: preserve-3d;
      transition: transform 0.18s ease-out, box-shadow 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease;
      will-change: transform;
    }

    .tilt-depth-1 {
      transform: translateZ(28px);
    }

    .tilt-depth-2 {
      transform: translateZ(52px);
    }

    .tilt-depth-3 {
      transform: translateZ(75px);
    }

    /* Hologram Scanlines & 3D Portrait Effects */
    .hologram-scanlines {
      background: repeating-linear-gradient(
        0deg,
        rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.0) 0px,
        rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.0) 2px,
        rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.09) 3px,
        rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.0) 4px
      );
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    @keyframes floatSlow {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0px) translateZ(45px); }
      50% { transform: translateY(-8px) translateZ(55px); }
    }

    @keyframes pulseRing {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.45; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 0.85; transform: scale(1.03); }
    }

    .float-badge {
      animation: floatSlow 4.2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .float-badge-delayed {
      animation: floatSlow 4.8s ease-in-out 1.4s infinite;
    }

    .ring-pulse {
      animation: pulseRing 3.6s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .glass-panel {
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.62);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.11);
    }

    .glass-panel-strong {
      background: rgba(10, 15, 30, 0.82);
      backdrop-filter: blur(22px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(22px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
    }

    /* Custom Scrollbar */
    ::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
    }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
      background: #060914;
    }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: #1e293b;
      border-radius: 9999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
      background: #334155;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body class="selection:bg-cyan-400 selection:text-slate-950">

  <!-- Dynamic Transforming Background & 3D WebGL Canvas -->
  <div id="scroll-backdrop"></div>
  <div id="cyber-grid"></div>
  <canvas id="webgl-canvas"></canvas>

  <!-- Top Sticky Navigation Bar -->
  <header class="fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-10 py-3">
    <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto glass-panel rounded-2xl px-4 sm:px-6 py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between shadow-2xl">
      <!-- Brand / Repo Single-Origin Identity -->
      <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
        <div class="relative w-10 h-10 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-cyan-400/50 shadow-lg shadow-cyan-500/20 flex-shrink-0">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Gautam 3D Avatar" class="w-full h-full object-cover" />
          <span class="absolute bottom-0.5 right-0.5 w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 ring-2 ring-slate-950"></span>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="font-bold tracking-tight text-white text-sm sm:text-base">Gautam369-web</span>
            <span class="text-slate-400 font-mono text-xs">/</span>
            <span class="font-mono text-xs sm:text-sm text-cyan-400 font-semibold">README.md</span>
          </div>
          <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 hidden sm:block">Single-Origin 3D Interactive Developer Profile • LPU, Punjab 🇮🇳</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Stage Switcher Links -->
      <nav class="hidden md:flex items-center gap-1 lg:gap-2 text-xs lg:text-sm font-medium">
        <button data-scroll-to="section-hero" class="nav-link px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-cyan-300 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/15 transition">01. Origin 3D</button>
        <button data-scroll-to="section-stayzen" class="nav-link px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition">02. Stayzen79 🏠</button>
        <button data-scroll-to="section-arsenal" class="nav-link px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition">03. Tech Arsenal</button>
        <button data-scroll-to="section-linux" class="nav-link px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition">04. Linux & Wayland</button>
        <button data-scroll-to="section-readme" class="nav-link px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition">05. README.md Code</button>
      </nav>

      <!-- Live Theme / Stage Badge & README Export Action -->
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
        <div class="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-white/10 text-xs font-mono">
          <span id="stage-dot" class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-cyan-400 animate-pulse"></span>
          <span id="stage-indicator" class="text-slate-200">STAGE 01: CYBER ORIGIN</span>
        </div>
        <button id="open-readme-modal-btn" class="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-indigo-600 hover:from-cyan-400 hover:to-indigo-500 text-slate-950 font-semibold text-xs sm:text-sm flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-lg shadow-cyan-500/20 transition">
          <i data-lucide="file-code-2" class="w-4 h-4"></i>
          <span>Export README.md</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Scroll Progress Bar -->
    <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto mt-1.5 px-2">
      <div class="w-full h-1 bg-slate-800/70 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
        <div id="scroll-progress-bar" class="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 via-indigo-500 to-emerald-400 transition-all duration-150" style="width: 8%;"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <!-- Floating Right-Side 3D Scroll Morph Controller -->
  <aside class="fixed right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-30 hidden xl:flex flex-col gap-3 glass-panel p-2.5 rounded-2xl">
    <button data-scroll-to="section-hero" title="01. Identity & 3D Avatar" class="stage-pill w-3 h-8 rounded-full bg-cyan-400 transition-all duration-300"></button>
    <button data-scroll-to="section-stayzen" title="02. Stayzen79 Ecosystem" class="stage-pill w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-white/25 hover:bg-white/50 transition-all duration-300"></button>
    <button data-scroll-to="section-arsenal" title="03. Tech Arsenal Matrix" class="stage-pill w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-white/25 hover:bg-white/50 transition-all duration-300"></button>
    <button data-scroll-to="section-linux" title="04. Multi-OS & Wayland Lab" class="stage-pill w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-white/25 hover:bg-white/50 transition-all duration-300"></button>
    <button data-scroll-to="section-readme" title="05. GitHub README.md Studio" class="stage-pill w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-white/25 hover:bg-white/50 transition-all duration-300"></button>
  </aside>

  <!-- Main Content Wrapper -->
  <main class="relative z-10 pt-28 pb-24 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-10 max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-28 sm:space-y-36">

    <!-- =====================================================================
         SECTION 01: HERO — 3D CHARACTER PORTRAIT & SINGLE-ORIGIN IDENTITY
         ===================================================================== -->
    <section id="section-hero" data-stage="0" class="min-h-[85vh] flex flex-col justify-center">
      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-10 lg:gap-12 items-center">

        <!-- Left Column: Developer Identity, JSON Telemetry & Quick Actions -->
        <div class="lg:col-span-7 space-y-6">
          <div class="inline-flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full glass-panel text-xs font-mono text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-400/30">
            <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-ping"></span>
            <span>status: "Always building something 🔨"</span>
            <span class="text-slate-500">|</span>
            <span class="text-indigo-300">Punjab, India 🇮🇳 • LPU</span>
          </div>

          <div class="space-y-3">
            <p class="font-mono text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-widest text-cyan-400">
              github.com/Gautam369-web/README.md • Single-Origin 3D Experience
            </p>
            <h1 class="text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tight leading-[1.06]">
              Hi, I'm <span class="text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-300 via-sky-400 to-indigo-400">Gautam</span>
              <span class="block text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold text-slate-300 mt-2 font-mono">
                aka <span class="text-cyan-400">@Gautam369</span> — Full Stack Developer
              </span>
            </h1>
          </div>

          <p class="text-base sm:text-lg text-slate-300 max-w-2xl leading-relaxed">
            Passionate about <span class="text-white font-semibold underline decoration-cyan-400/60 underline-offset-4">"Building products that solve real problems"</span>.
            Currently architecting <span class="text-emerald-300 font-semibold">Stayzen79 🏠</span> — a next-generation
            <span class="text-slate-100">Student Living Ecosystem Platform</span> powered by
            <span class="font-mono text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-white/10 text-cyan-300">Next.js</span>,
            <span class="font-mono text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-white/10 text-emerald-300">MongoDB</span>, and
            <span class="font-mono text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-white/10 text-sky-300">Tailwind</span>,
            while mastering multi-distro Linux security &amp; <span class="text-purple-300 font-semibold">Wayland</span> window managers.
          </p>

          <!-- Core Identity Telemetry Badges -->
          <div class="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3 pt-1">
            <div class="glass-panel rounded-2xl p-3.5 border-l-2 border-l-cyan-400">
              <div class="text-[11px] font-mono uppercase text-slate-400">Name / Alias</div>
              <div class="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-white mt-0.5">Gautam <span class="text-cyan-400 font-mono text-xs">(Gautam369)</span></div>
            </div>
            <div class="glass-panel rounded-2xl p-3.5 border-l-2 border-l-indigo-400">
              <div class="text-[11px] font-mono uppercase text-slate-400">University</div>
              <div class="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-white mt-0.5">LPU <span class="text-xs font-normal text-slate-300">Punjab 🇮🇳</span></div>
            </div>
            <div class="glass-panel rounded-2xl p-3.5 border-l-2 border-l-emerald-400">
              <div class="text-[11px] font-mono uppercase text-slate-400">Current Project</div>
              <div class="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-emerald-300 mt-0.5">Stayzen79 🏠</div>
            </div>
            <div class="glass-panel rounded-2xl p-3.5 border-l-2 border-l-purple-400">
              <div class="text-[11px] font-mono uppercase text-slate-400">OS &amp; Compositor</div>
              <div class="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-purple-300 mt-0.5">Linux + Wayland</div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Interactive CTA Controls -->
          <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 pt-2">
            <button data-scroll-to="section-stayzen" class="px-5 py-3 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 to-indigo-500 hover:from-cyan-300 hover:to-indigo-400 text-slate-950 font-bold text-sm flex items-center gap-2 shadow-xl shadow-cyan-500/20 transition">
              <span>Explore Stayzen79 🏠</span>
              <i data-lucide="arrow-down-right" class="w-4 h-4"></i>
            </button>
            <button data-scroll-to="section-linux" class="px-5 py-3 rounded-xl glass-panel hover:bg-white/10 text-white font-semibold text-sm flex items-center gap-2 border border-white/15 transition">
              <i data-lucide="terminal" class="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400"></i>
              <span>Launch Linux &amp; Wayland Lab</span>
            </button>
            <button id="hero-copy-json-btn" class="px-4 py-3 rounded-xl glass-panel hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-200 font-mono text-xs flex items-center gap-2 border border-white/10 transition">
              <i data-lucide="braces" class="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400"></i>
              <span>Copy Profile JSON</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Right Column: Interactive 3D Portrait Rig created from the uploaded picture -->
        <div class="lg:col-span-5 perspective-container flex flex-col items-center">
          <div id="hero-3d-card" class="tilt-card relative w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl glass-panel-strong p-5 sm:p-6 border border-cyan-400/40 shadow-[0_25px_70px_-15px_rgba(0,242,254,0.3)]">

            <!-- Floating 3D Depth Badges -->
            <div class="float-badge absolute -top-4 -left-3 sm:-left-5 z-30 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-2xl glass-panel-strong border border-cyan-400/50 shadow-xl flex items-center gap-2">
              <span class="text-lg">🇮🇳</span>
              <div>
                <div class="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase text-cyan-300">Location</div>
                <div class="text-xs font-bold text-white">Punjab, India • LPU</div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="float-badge-delayed absolute -bottom-4 -right-3 sm:-right-5 z-30 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-2xl glass-panel-strong border border-emerald-400/50 shadow-xl flex items-center gap-2">
              <span class="text-lg">🏠</span>
              <div>
                <div class="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase text-emerald-300">Building Now</div>
                <div class="text-xs font-bold text-white">Stayzen79 Platform</div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Top Card Header -->
            <div class="tilt-depth-1 flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-rose-500"></span>
                <span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-amber-400"></span>
                <span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400"></span>
                <span class="ml-1 font-mono text-xs text-slate-300">gautam369_avatar_3d.glb</span>
              </div>
              <span id="portrait-mode-badge" class="font-mono text-[11px] px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-400/30">
                3D Stylized Mode
              </span>
            </div>

            <!-- Interactive 3D Portrait Viewport -->
            <div id="portrait-viewport" class="tilt-depth-2 relative w-full aspect-square rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-slate-950 border border-white/15 group select-none">
              <!-- Ambient Neon Halo Ring behind Portrait -->
              <div class="ring-pulse absolute inset-4 rounded-full border-2 border-dashed border-cyan-400/40 pointer-events-none z-10"></div>

              <!-- Layer 1: 3D Stylized Render from Uploaded Photo -->
              <img
                id="img-3d-stylized"
                src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"
                alt="Gautam 3D Stylized Developer Avatar"
                class="w-full h-full object-cover transition-all duration-500"
              />

              <!-- Layer 2: Original Uploaded Photo with 3D Holographic Depth Filter (Clipped in Split Mode or Full in Hologram Mode) -->
              <div id="img-orig-wrapper" class="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden transition-opacity duration-300" style="opacity: 0; clip-path: inset(0 50% 0 0);">
                <img
                  id="img-orig-photo"
                  src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"
                  alt="Gautam Original Portrait in 3D Depth"
                  class="w-full h-full object-cover scale-105 filter contrast-110 saturate-110"
                />
                <!-- Cyan/Indigo 3D Depth Lighting Overlay on Original Photo -->
                <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-tr from-cyan-500/25 via-transparent to-indigo-500/30 mix-blend-overlay"></div>
              </div>

              <!-- Hologram Scanline & Depth Grid Overlay -->
              <div id="hologram-overlay" class="hologram-scanlines absolute inset-0 z-20 opacity-60"></div>

              <!-- Split Morph Slider Control (Visible in Split Compare Mode) -->
              <div id="split-slider-overlay" class="hidden absolute inset-x-4 bottom-3 z-30 glass-panel px-3 py-2 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-3">
                <span class="font-mono text-[10px] text-cyan-300 whitespace-nowrap">Original Photo</span>
                <input id="morph-slider" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="50" class="w-full accent-cyan-400 cursor-pointer h-1.5 bg-slate-700 rounded-lg" />
                <span class="font-mono text-[10px] text-indigo-300 whitespace-nowrap">3D Avatar</span>
              </div>

              <!-- Bottom Overlay Info Strip inside Viewport -->
              <div class="absolute inset-x-3 bottom-3 z-20 pointer-events-none flex items-end justify-between" id="viewport-caption">
                <div class="glass-panel px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl">
                  <div class="text-xs font-bold text-white">Gautam (@Gautam369)</div>
                  <div class="text-[10px] font-mono text-cyan-300">Full Stack Developer • LPU</div>
                </div>
                <div class="glass-panel px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-300">
                  Move cursor to tilt 3D
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- 3D View Mode Switcher Buttons -->
            <div class="tilt-depth-1 mt-4 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              <button data-portrait-mode="3d" class="portrait-mode-btn px-2.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-cyan-500 text-slate-950 shadow-md transition">
                3D Stylized
              </button>
              <button data-portrait-mode="split" class="portrait-mode-btn px-2.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-white/10 text-slate-200 hover:bg-white/15 transition">
                50/50 3D Morph
              </button>
              <button data-portrait-mode="hologram" class="portrait-mode-btn px-2.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-white/10 text-slate-200 hover:bg-white/15 transition">
                3D Holo Original
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- =====================================================================
         SECTION 02: CURRENT PROJECT — STAYZEN79 🏠 STUDENT LIVING ECOSYSTEM
         ===================================================================== -->
    <section id="section-stayzen" data-stage="1" class="scroll-mt-28 space-y-10">
      <div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-end justify-between gap-4 border-b border-white/10 pb-6">
        <div>
          <div class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-xs text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-2">
            <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400"></span>
            <span>Stage 02 • Flagship Venture &amp; Architecture</span>
          </div>
          <h2 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black tracking-tight text-white">
            Stayzen79 🏠 <span class="text-emerald-400 font-light">—</span> Student Living Ecosystem Platform
          </h2>
        </div>
        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-400/40 text-emerald-300 font-mono text-xs">Next.js</span>
          <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-teal-500/20 border border-teal-400/40 text-teal-300 font-mono text-xs">MongoDB</span>
          <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-cyan-500/20 border border-cyan-400/40 text-cyan-300 font-mono text-xs">Tailwind CSS</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Interactive Stayzen79 3D Showcase Grid -->
      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-stretch">
        <!-- Left 7 Cols: Interactive Module Explorer for Stayzen79 -->
        <div class="lg:col-span-7 glass-panel-strong rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 border border-emerald-400/30 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-6">
          <div class="space-y-4">
            <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <span class="font-mono text-xs px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-400/30">
                currentProject: "Stayzen79 🏠"
              </span>
              <span class="font-mono text-xs text-slate-400">Built at LPU, Punjab 🇮🇳</span>
            </div>

            <h3 class="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold text-white">

  <!-- Main Application Script -->
  <script>
    // Initialize Lucide icons safely
    if (window.lucide) {
      window.lucide.createIcons();
    }

    // Toast Helper (No browser alert/confirm/prompt)
    let toastTimer = null;
    function showToast(msg) {
      const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
      const text = document.getElementById('toast-message');
      if (!toast || !text) return;
      text.textContent = msg;
      toast.classList.remove('hidden');
      toast.classList.add('flex');
      if (toastTimer) clearTimeout(toastTimer);
      toastTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.add('hidden');
        toast.classList.remove('flex');
      }, 3200);
    }

    // Safe Clipboard Helper
    function copyTextToClipboard(text, successMsg) {
      if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
          showToast(successMsg);
        }).catch(() => {
          fallbackCopy(text, successMsg);
        });
      } else {
        fallbackCopy(text, successMsg);
      }
    }

    function fallbackCopy(text, successMsg) {
      const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
      ta.value = text;
      ta.style.position = 'fixed';
      ta.style.opacity = '0';
      document.body.appendChild(ta);
      ta.select();
      try {
        document.execCommand('copy');
        showToast(successMsg);
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Press Ctrl+C to copy from the README studio box.');
      }
      document.body.removeChild(ta);
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 1. POPULATE GITHUB README.MD MARKDOWN CONTENT
    // =========================================================================
    const readmeMarkdown = `# <div align="center">👋 Hi, I'm Gautam (@Gautam369)</div>

<div align="center">
  <strong>Full Stack Developer • LPU, Punjab, India 🇮🇳 • Always building something 🔨</strong>
</div>

---

### 🚀 Single-Origin Developer Telemetry

\`\`\`ts
const gautam = {
  name: "Gautam",
  alias: "Gautam369",
  location: "Punjab, India 🇮🇳",

  role: "Full Stack Developer",
  
  currentProject: "Stayzen79 🏠",

  status: "Always building something 🔨"

### 🛠️ Tech Arsenal

#### 🎨 Frontend
\`Next.js\` • \`React.js\` • \`TypeScript\` • \`JavaScript (ES6+)\` • \`Tailwind CSS\` • \`Three.js / WebGL\` • \`Framer Motion\` • \`Redux Toolkit\` • \`HTML5 / CSS3\`

#### 🗄️ Backend & Database
\`Node.js\` • \`Express.js\` • \`MongoDB\` • \`Mongoose\` • \`PostgreSQL\` • \`Prisma\` • \`Redis\` • \`RESTful APIs & Server Actions\`

#### 🔐 Auth & Integrations
\`NextAuth.js / Auth.js\` • \`JWT & OAuth 2.0\` • \`Firebase Auth\` • \`Clerk\` • \`Razorpay / Stripe\` • \`Cloudinary\` • \`Socket.io / WebSockets\`

#### ⚙️ Tools & Workflow
\`Git & GitHub (Gautam369-web)\` • \`Docker\` • \`VS Code / Neovim\` • \`Vercel\` • \`Postman\` • \`GitHub Actions CI/CD\` • \`Zsh / Bash\` • \`Figma\`

### 🐧 Multi-OS Linux & Window Manager Mastery
- **Linux Distributions:** \`Kali Linux\` 🐉 • \`Parrot OS\` 🦜 • \`Garuda Linux\` 🦅 • \`Arch Linux\` • \`Ubuntu / Debian\` & many more
- **Display Server & Window Managers:** \`Wayland\` protocol • \`Hyprland\` / \`Sway\` dynamic tiling window managers • \`Waybar\` • \`Kitty / Alacritty\` GPU terminals
`;

    const readmeBox = document.getElementById('readme-markdown-box');
    const modalPreview = document.getElementById('modal-readme-preview');
    if (readmeBox) readmeBox.value = readmeMarkdown;
    if (modalPreview) modalPreview.textContent = readmeMarkdown;

    // Copy & Download Handlers
    document.getElementById('copy-readme-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
      copyTextToClipboard(readmeMarkdown, 'Copied Gautam369-web/README.md to clipboard!');
      const pill = document.getElementById('copy-status-pill');
      if (pill) pill.textContent = 'Copied to Clipboard ✓';
    });

    document.getElementById('hero-copy-json-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const jsonSnippet = JSON.stringify({
        name: "Gautam",
        alias: "Gautam369",
        location: "Punjab, India 🇮🇳",
        university: "LPU",
        role: "Full Stack Developer",
        currentProject: "Stayzen79 🏠",
        projectDesc: "Student Living Ecosystem Platform",
        stack: ["Next.js", "MongoDB", "Tailwind"],
        passion: "Building products that solve real problems",
        linuxDistros: ["Kali Linux", "Parrot OS", "Garuda Linux", "Arch", "Ubuntu"],
        windowManager: "Wayland",
        status: "Always building something 🔨"
      }, null, 2);
      copyTextToClipboard(jsonSnippet, 'Copied Gautam369 profile JSON to clipboard!');
    });

    document.getElementById('download-readme-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const blob = new Blob([readmeMarkdown], { type: 'text/markdown;charset=utf-8' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = 'README.md';
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      showToast('Downloaded README.md for Gautam369-web!');
    });

    // Modal Open / Close
    const readmeModal = document.getElementById('readme-modal');
    document.getElementById('open-readme-modal-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
      readmeModal.classList.remove('hidden');
      readmeModal.classList.add('flex');
    });
    document.getElementById('close-readme-modal-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
      readmeModal.classList.add('hidden');
      readmeModal.classList.remove('flex');
    });
    document.getElementById('modal-copy-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
      copyTextToClipboard(readmeMarkdown, 'Copied README.md Markdown from modal!');
    });

    // =========================================================================
    // 2. INTERACTIVE 3D PORTRAIT SWITCHER & SPLIT MORPH SLIDER
    // =========================================================================
    const imgOrigWrapper = document.getElementById('img-orig-wrapper');
    const splitSliderOverlay = document.getElementById('split-slider-overlay');
    const morphSlider = document.getElementById('morph-slider');
    const portraitModeBadge = document.getElementById('portrait-mode-badge');
    const viewportCaption = document.getElementById('viewport-caption');
    const portraitBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.portrait-mode-btn');

    function setPortraitMode(mode) {
      portraitBtns.forEach(btn => {
        const isCurrent = btn.getAttribute('data-portrait-mode') === mode;
        btn.className = isCurrent
          ? 'portrait-mode-btn px-2.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-cyan-400 text-slate-950 shadow-md transition'
          : 'portrait-mode-btn px-2.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-white/10 text-slate-200 hover:bg-white/15 transition';
      });

      if (mode === '3d') {
        imgOrigWrapper.style.opacity = '0';
        splitSliderOverlay.classList.add('hidden');
        viewportCaption.classList.remove('hidden');
        portraitModeBadge.textContent = '3D Stylized Mode';
      } else if (mode === 'split') {
        imgOrigWrapper.style.opacity = '1';
        const val = morphSlider.value;
        imgOrigWrapper.style.clipPath = `inset(0 ${100 - val}% 0 0)`;
        splitSliderOverlay.classList.remove('hidden');
        viewportCaption.classList.add('hidden');
        portraitModeBadge.textContent = '50/50 3D Morph Slider';
      } else if (mode === 'hologram') {
        imgOrigWrapper.style.opacity = '1';
        imgOrigWrapper.style.clipPath = 'inset(0 0% 0 0)';
        splitSliderOverlay.classList.add('hidden');
        viewportCaption.classList.remove('hidden');
        portraitModeBadge.textContent = '3D Holo Original';
      }
    }

    portraitBtns.forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        setPortraitMode(btn.getAttribute('data-portrait-mode'));
      });
    });

    morphSlider.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
      const val = e.target.value;
      imgOrigWrapper.style.clipPath = `inset(0 ${100 - val}% 0 0)`;
    });

    // =========================================================================
    // 3. 3D PERSPECTIVE TILT CARDS ON CURSOR MOVE
    // =========================================================================
    const tiltCards = document.querySelectorAll('.tilt-card');
    tiltCards.forEach(card => {
      card.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
        const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
        const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
        const centerX = rect.width / 2;
        const centerY = rect.height / 2;
        const rotateX = ((y - centerY) / centerY) * -8;
        const rotateY = ((x - centerX) / centerX) * 8;
        card.style.transform = `rotateX(${rotateX.toFixed(2)}deg) rotateY(${rotateY.toFixed(2)}deg)`;
      });
      card.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
        card.style.transform = 'rotateX(0deg) rotateY(0deg)';
      });
    });

    // =========================================================================
    // 4. STAYZEN79 🏠 INTERACTIVE MODULE TABS
    // =========================================================================
    const stayzenData = {
      housing: {
        title: 'Verified Student Housing & 3D Room Tours',
        tag: 'Next.js App Router + MongoDB GeoJSON',
        desc: 'Real-time filtering for student PGs, flats, and hostels near LPU & Punjab campuses with transparent rent breakdowns, verified landlord badges, distance-to-gate metrics, and instant booking requests.',
        m1Label: 'Search Engine', m1Val: 'MongoDB Atlas Search',
        m2Label: 'UI Rendering', m2Val: 'Next.js SSR + Tailwind',
        m3Label: 'Target Impact', m3Val: 'Zero Broker Friction'

      roommates: {
        title: 'Compatibility-Driven Roommate Finder',
        tag: 'Smart Matching Algorithm + Real-Time Chat',
        desc: 'Matches LPU & university students based on study schedules, coding habits, sleep cycles, budget ranges, and shared interests so students build thriving micro-communities.',

        m2Label: 'Messaging', m2Val: 'Authenticated Channels',
        m3Label: 'Student Safety', m3Val: 'University ID Verified'
      },
      services: {
        title: 'Hyperlocal Mess, Laundry & Study Hub Ecosystem',
        tag: 'Unified Student Living Dashboard',
        desc: 'Connects residents with nearby tiffin/mess subscriptions, laundry pickup, high-speed Wi-Fi diagnostics, and digital rent splitting inside one cohesive platform.',
        m1Label: 'Architecture', m1Val: 'Modular Micro-Workflows',
        m2Label: 'Database', m2Val: 'MongoDB Aggregations',
        m3Label: 'Experience', m3Val: 'Mobile-First PWA Ready'
      }
    };

    document.querySelectorAll('.stayzen-tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const key = btn.getAttribute('data-stayzen-tab');
        const info = stayzenData[key];
        if (!info) return;

        document.querySelectorAll('.stayzen-tab-btn').forEach(b => {
          b.className = b === btn
            ? 'stayzen-tab-btn px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 transition'
            : 'stayzen-tab-btn px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-white/10 text-slate-200 hover:bg-white/15 transition';
        });

        document.getElementById('stayzen-mod-title').textContent = info.title;
        document.getElementById('stayzen-mod-tag').textContent = info.tag;
        document.getElementById('stayzen-mod-desc').textContent = info.desc;
        document.getElementById('stayzen-mod-metrics').innerHTML = `
          <div class="bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl p-3 border border-white/5">
            <div class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono">${info.m1Label}</div>
            <div class="text-sm font-bold text-white mt-0.5">${info.m1Val}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl p-3 border border-white/5">
            <div class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono">${info.m2Label}</div>
            <div class="text-sm font-bold text-white mt-0.5">${info.m2Val}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl p-3 border border-white/5">
            <div class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono">${info.m3Label}</div>
            <div class="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-300 mt-0.5">${info.m3Val}</div>
          </div>
        `;
      });
    });

    // =========================================================================
    // 5. TECH ARSENAL FILTERING
    // =========================================================================
    document.querySelectorAll('.arsenal-filter-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const filter = btn.getAttribute('data-arsenal-filter');
        document.querySelectorAll('.arsenal-filter-btn').forEach(b => {
          b.className = b === btn
            ? 'arsenal-filter-btn px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-purple-500 text-slate-950 transition'
            : 'arsenal-filter-btn px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-white/10 text-slate-200 hover:bg-white/15 transition';
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('[data-arsenal-card]').forEach(card => {
          const cat = card.getAttribute('data-arsenal-card');
          if (filter === 'all' || cat === filter) {
            card.classList.remove('hidden');
          } else {
            card.classList.add('hidden');
          }
        });
      });
    });

    // =========================================================================
    // 6. MULTI-OS LINUX & WAYLAND COMPOSITOR SIMULATOR
    // =========================================================================
    const distroProfiles = {
      kali: {
        badge: 'KALI-WAYLAND',
        ascii: `            ..,;:ccc,.
          ......''';lxO.
.....''''..........,:ld;
           .';;;:::;,,.x,
      ..'''.            0Xxoc:,.  ...
  ....                ,ONkc;,;cokOdc',.
 .                   OMo           ':ddo.
                    dMc               :OO;
                    0M.                 .:o.`,
        os: 'Kali GNU/Linux Rolling x86_64',
        kernel: '6.11.2-kali-amd64',
        wm: 'Wayland (Hyprland / Sway Tiling Compositor)',
        shell: 'zsh 5.9 + oh-my-zsh',
        pkgs: '3140 (dpkg) • NetHunter & Sec Auditing Suite',
        note: 'Offensive security, network analysis & full-stack dev rig'
      },
      parrot: {
        badge: 'PARROT-SEC-WAYLAND',
        ascii: `  .\`        \`.
  / \\      / \\
 /   \\____/   \\
/              \\
|  (o)    (o)  |
|      /\\      |
 \\    '--'    /
  '.________.'`,
        os: 'Parrot Security OS 6.2 (Lorikeet) x86_64',
        kernel: '6.10.11-parrot-amd64',
        wm: 'Wayland Compositor + AnonSurf Overlay',
        shell: 'zsh 5.9 (Parrot Custom)',
        pkgs: '2680 (dpkg) • Sandboxed Privacy & Cloud Sec',
        note: 'Hardened privacy environment & lightweight container workflow'
      },
      garuda: {
        badge: 'GARUDA-DR460NIZED',
        ascii: `         .---.
        /     \\
       | () () |
        \\  ^  /
         |||||
     .___|||||___.
    /   Garuda    \\`,
        os: 'Garuda Linux (Arch Rolling) x86_64',
        kernel: '6.11.5-zen1-1-zen (Performance Tuned)',
        wm: 'Wayland (Hyprland Dynamic Tiler + Waybar)',
        shell: 'fish / zsh + Starship Prompt',
        pkgs: '1890 (pacman) • Btrfs Snapper Auto-Snapshots',
        note: 'Bleeding-edge Arch performance & gaming/3D WebGL workstation'
      },
      wayland: {
        badge: 'WAYLAND-COMPOSITOR',
        ascii: `  +-------------------+
  |  W A Y L A N D    |
  |  +------+ +-----+ |
  |  | Tile | |Tile | |
  |  |  01  | | 02  | |
  |  +------+ +-----+ |
  +-------------------+`,
        os: 'Multi-OS Linux (Kali / Parrot / Garuda / Arch / Ubuntu)',
        kernel: 'Linux 6.11 Zen & Security Kernels',
        wm: 'Wayland Display Server (Hyprland, Sway, River, Waybar)',
        shell: 'Kitty / Alacritty GPU Accelerated + Tmux',
        pkgs: 'Custom Dotfiles • Wofi • Mako • Grim/Slurp',
        note: 'Zero-tearing Wayland protocol with keyboard-driven tiling'
      }
    };

    function renderDistroProfile(key) {
      const p = distroProfiles[key] || distroProfiles.kali;
      document.getElementById('waybar-distro-badge').textContent = p.badge;
      const out = document.getElementById('neofetch-output');
      out.textContent = `${p.ascii}

gautam@Gautam369
----------------
OS       : ${p.os}
Host     : LPU Developer Rig (Punjab, India 🇮🇳)
Kernel   : ${p.kernel}
Session  : ${p.wm}
Shell    : ${p.shell}
Packages : ${p.pkgs}
Project  : Stayzen79 🏠 (Next.js + MongoDB + Tailwind)
Status   : Always building something 🔨
Focus    : ${p.note}`;
    }

    renderDistroProfile('kali');

    document.querySelectorAll('.distro-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const key = btn.getAttribute('data-distro');
        document.querySelectorAll('.distro-btn').forEach(b => {
          b.className = b === btn
            ? 'distro-btn px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-semibold bg-cyan-400 text-slate-950 transition'
            : 'distro-btn px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-semibold bg-white/10 text-slate-200 hover:bg-white/15 transition';
        });
        renderDistroProfile(key);
      });
    });

    const shellResponses = {
      'whoami': '$ whoami => Gautam (alias: Gautam369) | Full Stack Developer @ LPU, Punjab, India 🇮🇳',
      'os-list': '$ ls /os/installed => kali-linux  parrot-os  garuda-linux  arch-linux  ubuntu-server  debian',
      'wayland-info': '$ echo $XDG_SESSION_TYPE => wayland | Compositors: Hyprland, Sway, Waybar, Kitty GPU Terminal',
      'stayzen': '$ stayzen79 --status => [ONLINE] Student Living Ecosystem Platform (Next.js + MongoDB + Tailwind)'
    };

    document.querySelectorAll('.shell-cmd-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const cmd = btn.getAttribute('data-shell-cmd');
        const out = document.getElementById('shell-output');
        if (out && shellResponses[cmd]) {
          out.textContent = shellResponses[cmd];
        }
      });
    });

    // Smooth Scroll Navigation Buttons
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-scroll-to]').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const targetId = btn.getAttribute('data-scroll-to');
        const el = document.getElementById(targetId);
        if (el) {
          el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
        }
      });
    });

    // =========================================================================
    // 7. THREE.JS 3D SCENE & SCROLL-DRIVEN BACKGROUND TRANSFORMATION
    // =========================================================================
    const stages = [
      {
        name: 'STAGE 01: CYBER ORIGIN',
        bgPrimary: '#060914',
        bgSecondary: '#0f172a',
        glow: 'rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.25)',
        dotClass: 'bg-cyan-400',
        wireColor: 0x00f2fe,
        ringColor: 0x6366f1,
        camZ: 13.5,
        rotSpeed: 0.004
      },
      {
        name: 'STAGE 02: STAYZEN79 🏠',
        bgPrimary: '#041412',
        bgSecondary: '#072a24',
        glow: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.26)',
        dotClass: 'bg-emerald-400',
        wireColor: 0x10b981,
        ringColor: 0x14b8a6,
        camZ: 11.2,
        rotSpeed: 0.006
      },
      {
        name: 'STAGE 03: TECH ARSENAL',
        bgPrimary: '#130722',
        bgSecondary: '#220e3b',
        glow: 'rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.26)',
        dotClass: 'bg-purple-400',
        wireColor: 0xa855f7,
        ringColor: 0xf59e0b,
        camZ: 10.0,
        rotSpeed: 0.008
      },
      {
        name: 'STAGE 04: LINUX & WAYLAND',
        bgPrimary: '#06120c',
        bgSecondary: '#181024',
        glow: 'rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.24)',
        dotClass: 'bg-rose-400',
        wireColor: 0xf43f5e,
        ringColor: 0x06b6d4,
        camZ: 9.2,
        rotSpeed: 0.010
      },
      {
        name: 'STAGE 05: README.MD STUDIO',
        bgPrimary: '#050811',
        bgSecondary: '#0d1526',
        glow: 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.24)',
        dotClass: 'bg-sky-400',
        wireColor: 0x38bdf8,
        ringColor: 0x818cf8,
        camZ: 12.0,
        rotSpeed: 0.005
      }
    ];

    let activeStageIndex = 0;
    const rootStyle = document.documentElement.style;
    const stageIndicator = document.getElementById('stage-indicator');
    const stageDot = document.getElementById('stage-dot');
    const stagePills = document.querySelectorAll('.stage-pill');
    const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link');

    function applyStageTheme(idx) {
      if (idx === activeStageIndex && stageIndicator.dataset.initialized === 'true') return;
      activeStageIndex = idx;
      stageIndicator.dataset.initialized = 'true';
      const st = stages[idx] || stages[0];

      rootStyle.setProperty('--bg-primary', st.bgPrimary);
      rootStyle.setProperty('--bg-secondary', st.bgSecondary);
      rootStyle.setProperty('--glow-rgba', st.glow);

      if (stageIndicator) stageIndicator.textContent = st.name;
      if (stageDot) {
        stageDot.className = `w-2 h-2 rounded-full animate-pulse ${st.dotClass}`;
      }

      stagePills.forEach((pill, i) => {
        pill.className = i === idx
          ? 'stage-pill w-3 h-8 rounded-full bg-cyan-400 transition-all duration-300'
          : 'stage-pill w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-white/25 hover:bg-white/50 transition-all duration-300';
      });

      navLinks.forEach((link, i) => {
        link.className = i === idx
          ? 'nav-link px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-cyan-300 bg-white/15 transition'
          : 'nav-link px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition';
      });

      if (window.updateThreeStageColors) {
        window.updateThreeStageColors(st);
      }
    }

    // Initialize Three.js Scene
    (function initThreeScene() {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('webgl-canvas');
      if (!canvas || !window.THREE) return;

      const scene = new THREE.Scene();
      const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 100);
      camera.position.z = 13.5;

      const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, alpha: true, antialias: true });
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
      renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));

      // Main 3D Morphing Core Group
      const coreGroup = new THREE.Group();
      scene.add(coreGroup);

      // Outer Wireframe Icosahedron
      const icoGeo = new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(3.6, 1);
      const icoMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: 0x00f2fe,
        wireframe: true,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.22
      });
      const icoMesh = new THREE.Mesh(icoGeo, icoMat);
      coreGroup.add(icoMesh);

      // Inner Torus Knot (Represents Linux / Wayland & Complex Full-Stack Architecture)
      const knotGeo = new THREE.TorusKnotGeometry(1.8, 0.42, 96, 16);
      const knotMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: 0x6366f1,
        wireframe: true,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.18
      });
      const knotMesh = new THREE.Mesh(knotGeo, knotMat);
      coreGroup.add(knotMesh);

      // Orbital Ring
      const ringGeo = new THREE.TorusGeometry(5.5, 0.03, 16, 100);
      const ringMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: 0x00f2fe,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.32
      });
      const ringMesh = new THREE.Mesh(ringGeo, ringMat);
      ringMesh.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2.6;
      coreGroup.add(ringMesh);

      // Floating 3D Starfield / Data Particles
      const particleCount = 420;
      const positions = new Float32Array(particleCount * 3);
      for (let i = 0; i < particleCount * 3; i += 3) {
        positions[i] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 34;
        positions[i + 1] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 34;
        positions[i + 2] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24;
      }
      const partGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      partGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
      const partMat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({
        color: 0x00f2fe,
        size: 0.07,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.65
      });
      const particles = new THREE.Points(partGeo, partMat);
      scene.add(particles);

      let targetCamZ = 13.5;
      let currentRotSpeed = 0.004;
      let mouseX = 0;
      let mouseY = 0;
      let scrollRatio = 0;

      window.updateThreeStageColors = function(st) {
        icoMat.color.setHex(st.wireColor);
        partMat.color.setHex(st.wireColor);
        knotMat.color.setHex(st.ringColor);
        ringMat.color.setHex(st.ringColor);
        targetCamZ = st.camZ;
        currentRotSpeed = st.rotSpeed;
      };

      window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
        mouseX = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth - 0.5) * 1.6;
        mouseY = (e.clientY / window.innerHeight - 0.5) * 1.6;
      });

      window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
        const maxScroll = Math.max(1, document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight);
        scrollRatio = window.scrollY / maxScroll;

        // Update top progress bar
        const bar = document.getElementById('scroll-progress-bar');
        if (bar) {
          bar.style.width = `${Math.max(6, Math.min(100, scrollRatio * 100))}%`;
        }

        // Shift cyber grid perspective slightly with scroll
        const grid = document.getElementById('cyber-grid');
        if (grid) {
          grid.style.backgroundPosition = `0px ${-window.scrollY * 0.25}px`;
        }

        // Determine active section based on viewport center
        const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section[data-stage]');
        let detectedIdx = 0;
        const triggerLine = window.innerHeight * 0.42;
        sections.forEach(sec => {
          const rect = sec.getBoundingClientRect();
          if (rect.top <= triggerLine) {
            detectedIdx = parseInt(sec.getAttribute('data-stage'), 10) || 0;
          }
        });
        applyStageTheme(detectedIdx);
      });

      window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
        camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
      });

      function animate() {
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);

        // Smoothly morph 3D meshes based on scroll position + stage speed
        icoMesh.rotation.y += currentRotSpeed;
        icoMesh.rotation.x += currentRotSpeed * 0.6;

        knotMesh.rotation.x -= currentRotSpeed * 1.2;
        knotMesh.rotation.z += currentRotSpeed * 0.9;

        // Scale inner/outer geometries dynamically as user scrolls through chapters
        const morphScale = 0.85 + Math.sin(scrollRatio * Math.PI) * 0.45;
        knotMesh.scale.set(morphScale, morphScale, morphScale);
        ringMesh.rotation.z += 0.003;

        // Subtle parallax with cursor + scroll twist
        coreGroup.rotation.y = scrollRatio * Math.PI * 1.6 + mouseX * 0.35;
        coreGroup.rotation.x = scrollRatio * Math.PI * 0.6 + mouseY * 0.25;
        particles.rotation.y = -scrollRatio * 0.8 + mouseX * 0.12;

        camera.position.z += (targetCamZ - camera.position.z) * 0.05;
        renderer.render(scene, camera);
      }

      applyStageTheme(0);
      animate();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
